newsitem.title: UK: Care UK to sell some businesses to Peverel.
newsitem.headline: Care UK to sell some businesses to Peverel.

text.p: Care UK Plc said on Friday it planned to sell off its non-core businesses to Peverel Holdings Limited for 13.5 million stg.

Care UK, which provides elderly nursing care and homes for the National Health Service (NHS), said in a statement it would sell its housing management and monitoring and investment business to fund further investment in its core business.
"The proceeds of this disposal will allow us to invest further in our core contracted care business," said Care UK chief executive Richard Clough.
Peverel is 50 percent owned by Westminster Health Care, a major provider of services for the elderly under state or private contracts.

The businesses due to be sold made a profit, before interest and tax, of 869,000 stg in the year ended 30 September 1995 and had net assets of 3.5 million stg. Care UK expects to raise 12.9 million stg from the sale after expenses.
The planned sell-off is due to be put before the shareholders for consideration at an extraordinary general meeting set for December 2 this year.

Over the last few years Care UK has built up a successful speciality nursing home business on provision of five to 10-year contracts from the NHS, thereby providing a secured revenue stream over a the contract period.
